verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Dagster has individual integration docs (dbt, Airbyte, Fivetran, dlt) but no structured catalog page that labels each connector's maturity tier, support level, or maintainer. Community commentary even notes Dagster's integrations lag Airflow's in breadth/maturity (dagster-comm-3), but there's no counter-evidence of a maturity/support catalog existing, so this is an unmet applicable axis rather than a dispute.
